traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Palmae, subfamily I Calamoideae: erect or climbing palms, sometimes suckering, with reduplicate leaves that are pinnate (some entire-pinnate) or rarely palmate, and fruit covered in overlapping reflexed scales; mostly Asian. Its tribes Eugeissoneae and Calameae have pinnate leaves.
